remainingFromOfficialList: Pasadena Area Community College District Measure UP is drafted but still lacks source-backed district identity and reader membership.
scope: New explainers address 14 measures genuinely absent from the held LA list, 13 attached and one community-college record held for identity/membership. This does not independently re-review the substance of the 54 existing LA explainers. Other California counties remain separate.

sourceNotes.finding: The public official contest publishes the complete question and impartial analysis but no separate full-text statement. Draft uses the prospective full-term language without inventing partial-term exceptions.

Operative exemption says age65 before June30, while analysis says on or before. Draft follows the operative strict before wording. Annual CPI adjustment can be reduced by the board; fallback parcel definition and funding-reduction clauses are retained in parts.

Operative full text limits senior/disability exemption to solely owner-occupied single-family parcels and sets June15 application deadline. Draft preserves both, along with automatic continuation of prior exemptions.
